#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Full-vocabulary dual-space sums, exact byte ETA, projector initialization and gradient contracts.
# CPU only. No model, GPU, optimizer, checkpoint, download or installation.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
PY="$(tinylm_python)"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage7lW_dskdv2_cpu -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 180s "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m unittest -v scripts.test_p106b_dskdv2_contract
